test.query: SELECT count() FROM numbers_mt(100000000) WHERE isValidUTF8(repeat(toString(number), 10)) AND number % 100 = 0 FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM numbers_mt(100000000) WHERE NOT isValidUTF8(repeat(toString(number), 10)) OR number % 100 != 0 FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(isValidUTF8(repeat(toString(number), 10)) AND number % 100 = 0) FROM numbers_mt(100000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(number % 3 != 0 AND intHash64(number) % 1000 != 5 AND bitAnd(number, 1023) = 7) FROM numbers_mt(300000000) SETTINGS short_circuit_function_evaluation = 'force_enable' FORMAT Null
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE short_circuit_reorder_json (j String, d Decimal(76, 38), s Nullable(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO short_circuit_reorder_json SELECT concat('{"k1":"', toString(cityHash64(number)), '","k2":"', repeat('p', 150), '","k7":"', if(number % 3 = 0, 'X', 'Connected'), '"}'), toDecimal256(cityHash64(number, 1) % 3600 / 14, 38), if(cityHash64(number, 2) % 10 = 0, concat('u', toString(number)), '') FROM numbers(20000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM short_circuit_reorder_json WHERE JSONExtractString(j, 'k7') = 'Connected' AND (d > 240 OR d IS NULL) AND s != '' SETTINGS optimize_move_to_prewhere = 0 FORMAT Null
